'''2007 Match Play Championship Day 1 Roy Bordier LS Local Uprising''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Roy Bordier]] at [[2007 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Local Uprising / Liberation|SE-L-localuprising.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Ray Bordier
* '''Deck name:''' Immortality
* '''Username:''' spectre
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
